claim: Post-load comparison verified 1,180 records, 1,164 files, 1,180 source-identifier pairs, and 2,360 language records. No orphaned bilingual pairs, duplicate identifiers, or version cycles were identified.

The recommendation is to add an automated checksum-change test, extend the place vocabulary, and retain the conservative person-link threshold. The next ingestion should reuse this set as regression data.
